candidate.title: Verified video shows wreckage of Saudi fighter jet shot down over Yemen
candidate.summary: BBC Verify tracks down the location of a Houthi video showing the wreckage of an F-15 they claim to have shot down.

editorial.why_now: Published today (Sept 17, 2026); active ongoing military situation affecting Saudi Arabia's security and regional operations.
